record.field: Quick answers to the questions shoppers ask most

field.name: body
field.p: Can't find your answer? Tap the chat button at the bottom right and ask us.

field.name: answer
field.p: Quick orders are packed at a store near you and usually arrive in minutes. The live timer on your order shows the exact estimate.

field.name: answer
field.p: Express covers products shipped from our warehouse. Delivery takes a few days depending on your pincode; the product page shows the time for yours.

record.field: How do I cancel an order?

field.name: answer
field.p: Open Orders, choose the order and tap Cancel. Quick orders can be cancelled until they are packed; Express orders until they are shipped.

record.field: When will I get my refund?

field.name: answer
field.p: Once a cancellation or return is approved, the refund goes back to where you paid from, or to your 369 Wallet if you chose that. The order page shows where it is.

record.field: An item was missing or damaged

field.name: answer
field.p: Open the order soon after delivery, tap Return or replace and choose the item. We'll arrange a replacement or a refund.

record.field: When you can cancel or return, and how refunds work

field.name: body

ul.li: Quick orders — can be cancelled until they are packed.
Express orders — can be cancelled until they are shipped.

field.p: If something arrives damaged, missing or wrong, open the order and tap Return or replace within the return window shown there. We'll arrange a replacement or a refund.
Refunds go back to where you paid from, or to your 369 Wallet if you choose it. The order page shows the refund as it moves.

record.field: Where we deliver, and how fast

field.name: body
field.p: Type your pincode at the top of any page to see whether we deliver to you, and how fast. These are the areas we serve today.

record.field: Chat, call or write to us

field.name: body
field.p: The quickest way to reach us is the chat - tap the button at the bottom right. You can also call or email us.

record.field: Computer parts and gear, in minutes or in days

field.name: body
field.p: 369 Mart brings computer parts, accessories and gear to your door - Quick delivery in minutes from a store near you, and Express delivery in days from our warehouse.
Order on the website, the app or WhatsApp: one account, one set of orders, one wallet.

field.name: body
field.p: We're always glad to hear from people who love technology and good service - in our stores, on delivery, and behind the scenes.
Write to us through the Contact page with a few lines about yourself.

field.name: body
field.p: Are you a brand or distributor of computer parts and accessories? We'd like to hear from you.
Write to us through the Contact page with what you sell and where.

field.name: body
field.p: For press questions, write to us through the Contact page and we'll get back to you.

field.p: By using the website, the app or WhatsApp ordering, you agree to these terms. Prices, offers and stock can change; the price you see at checkout is the price you pay.
Keep your sign-in to yourself. You are responsible for orders placed from your account.
An order is accepted when we confirm it. We may cancel an order we cannot fulfil, and refund anything you paid.

record.field: How we look after your data

field.name: body

p.b: Edit this page in Odoo before going live: 369 Mart > Page building > Info pages.

field.p: Your name, mobile number, addresses and orders - what we need to deliver to you and to help when something goes wrong.
We never sell your data. We share it only with the people who deliver your order and the payment provider who takes your payment.
You can change your notification settings any time in Account > Notifications, and ask us to delete your account through the Contact page.

field.p: The delivery charge, if any, and the expected time are shown in your cart before you pay. See Delivery areas for where we deliver.

record.field: If something went wrong and isn't fixed

field.name: body
field.p: If a problem with an order hasn't been solved through the chat, write to our grievance officer at the email below with your order number. We'll acknowledge it within 48 hours and work to resolve it.
